title: 26 Filipino seafarers from M/V Gingo return to Manila
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Twenty-six Filipino seafarers aboard the Liberian-flagged bulk carrier M/V Gingo arrived safely in Manila after the vessel was damaged in a strike while operating in Ukraine,…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Twenty-six Filipino seafarers aboard the Liberian-flagged bulk carrier M/V Gingo arrived safely in Manila after the vessel was damaged in a strike while operating in Ukraine, according to the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW). The seafarers arrived aboard Emirates Airlines Flight EK334 at Ninoy Aquino International Airport Terminal 3 on Sept. 12,
